name: Evidence-Preserving Context Compression
mechanism: Reduces retrieved passages with query-aware extractive or abstractive compression while retaining source anchors qualifiers and required claims.
use_when: Retrieved evidence exceeds the generation budget
Distractor text lowers answer quality despite adequate retrieval recall
avoid_when: Layout tables or long-range discourse carry the meaning
Omission risk is high and preservation cannot be verified
expected_effects: Lower context tokens and generation cost
Higher evidence density when preserved claims remain sufficient
failure_modes: Negation dates or qualifiers are dropped
Citation anchors drift away from original spans
required_evals: answer correctness under fixed retrieved evidence
tokens latency and compression fallback rate
